message: Dependency comparison is unavailable (HTTP 403). A repository administrator must enable Dependency graph and grant workflow access at https://github.com/owner/repo/settings/security_analysis. The API does not distinguish disabled configuration from denied access. PR dependency review cannot run; lockfile audits remain required.
Due to capacity constraints, jobs targeting macOS arm64 runners may experience longer queue times.
